summary: Fairfax Financial Holdings filed a 6-K reporting the pricing of a private offering of US$750 million senior notes due 2056 at 100% issue price with a 6.200% fixed coupon. Proceeds are for general corporate purposes. The notes are unsecured senior obligations not registered under the Securities Act, sold to QIBs under Rule 144A or non-US persons under Reg S. Closing is expected June 8, 2026, subject to customary conditions. This is a routine debt financing, not a special situation. No acquisition, tender, spin-off, or activist event. Standard corporate funding with no structural novelty triggering a special-situations classification.
